issues.claim: Architectural Surfaces (1150 Cranbury South River Rd) is an independent local stone/tile showroom
issues.problem: It is a national chain. The company's own 'find a showroom' page advertises 'our distinctive nationwide showrooms' and lists showrooms state by state (Florida section shown). The mapper's own note already said 'possibly a multi-location company - confirm independence'. That is an excluded type (chain).
issues.fix: Remove the entry from the zone list.

issues.claim: Danley 911 Home Services is a Jamesburg business at 1095 Cranbury - South River Rd, Suite 10, phone (732) 656-8208
issues.problem: The company's own homepage calls itself 'a full-service electrical contracting company in Monroe Township, New Jersey'. 1095 Cranbury South River Rd is in Monroe Township; 'Jamesburg 08831' is only the postal city. The listed phone also does not appear on the company site (search-returned company data shows a different number).
issues.fix: Drop from the Jamesburg zone (or move to the Monroe zone); never source a phone from a generic Google Maps search URL.

issues.claim: Wredeco, 1100 Cranbury South River Rd, Jamesburg
issues.problem: OSHA's establishment record for 1100 Cranbury South River Rd places it in Monroe Township, NJ. Same postal-city confusion as the rest of that corridor.
issues.fix: Move to the Monroe zone after a block/lot check; the 'Jamesburg' label here is the ZIP 08831 postal city, not the municipality.

issues.claim: Meadow View Care, 319 Spotswood Gravel Hill Rd, is an operating Jamesburg care facility
issues.problem: Two national senior-care directories file this address under Monroe Township, not Jamesburg borough. I could not confirm it is currently licensed or trading (a search summary claimed a 2021 state closure but the Monroe Township minutes I opened did not mention the facility, so that specific claim is unverified). It is carried on one map listing only.
issues.fix: Verify status/licence (NJ Department of Health) or drop; if kept, the town should read Monroe Township, not Jamesburg.

issues.claim: Cranbury-South River Road entries generally: Alert Sprinkler (1085 Suite 1), Savona Printing (1085), Jet Transportation (1095 Suite 6), Victory Worldwide (1045), Wredeco (1100), Architectural Surfaces (1150), Firstline Locksmith (893 #203)
issues.problem: Inference (reasoned from public records, not from a borough boundary document): this corridor runs through Monroe Township and South Brunswick, not Jamesburg borough. OSHA lists 1100 Cranbury South River Rd as Monroe Township; CBRE and LoopNet market 1065 and 773 Cranbury South River Rd as Monroe Township industrial; NJ child-care data returns both 'Jamesburg' and 'Monroe Twp' for the same 893 Cranbury South River Rd address. These seven entries therefore probably sit outside the zone.
issues.fix: Check block/lot municipality for each address before outreach and reassign Monroe parcels to the Monroe zone; keep only parcels verified inside the borough.

issues.claim: Archer Law Office notes: 'site also lists Trenton, Princeton, Somerville and Brick offices'
issues.problem: The firm's current site lists Hamilton, Raritan, Marlton and Florham Park alongside the Jamesburg office - not Trenton, Princeton, Somerville or Brick. Stale note.
issues.fix: Correct the notes; the entry itself (29 E Railroad Ave, (609) 842-9200) is accurate.

issues.claim: Law Office of Otto J. Kostbar, 5 Stockton Ave, Jamesburg, ~40 years in practice
issues.problem: The firm's live site confirms the phone, the practice areas and that the practice exists, but shows neither a street address nor a 40-year bio. The address is directory-sourced only (the mapper says so), so it is unverified rather than wrong.
issues.fix: Confirm the address by phone before any mailing or visit; soften the bio claim.

issues.claim: New Horizon Abstract cited only to nhabstract.com/company-highlights/ for the 31 E Railroad Ave address
issues.problem: The cited page contains no address or phone. The address and phone (732) 786-3040 are on the site's /contact-us/ page instead, so the citation does not support the claim even though the entry is correct.

issues.claim: Quadrant Design Architecture, LLC (6 James Barton Rd) included 'for completeness' although BuildZoom shows an inactive/expired NJ architecture authorization
issues.problem: Nothing found shows current trading, and the mapper's own source suggests it is dormant - a dead entry on an outreach list.
issues.fix: Drop, or hold until activity is confirmed.

issues.claim: Mozarts & Einsteins Preschool and Team ELM Childcare & Tutoring retained under group D 'childcare'
issues.problem: Scope risk, not a factual error. The exclusion list names schools; whether a licensed preschool/childcare counts is a judgement call the mapper flagged. Team ELM separately rests on one user-generated listing with no address and only weak contact data, which fails the list's own evidence standard.
issues.fix: Get an explicit owner decision on childcare; drop Team ELM regardless unless a licence record, website or map listing is found.

issues.claim: Coverage gap claims (no roofing/siding/window/pool/security contractor, no gym in the borough)
issues.problem: Not an error - my independent roofing search reproduced it (results were Monroe Township firms or firms advertising Jamesburg as a service area). But it leaves several group C categories empty, and the earlier pass's Angi/BBB blocks mean the gap is asserted rather than proven.
issues.fix: Carry the gap forward in the hand-off so the team does not re-search it.

issues.claim: No excluded types elsewhere in the list
issues.problem: Full scan of all entries found no restaurants/food, groceries, liquor, gas, banks, government offices, public schools, hospitals, places of worship or pharmacy chains. Architectural Surfaces is the one clear chain (above). European Granite / Marble / Surfaces may be a multi-branch group but I could not confirm it - the group 'locations' page I opened was an unpopulated lorem-ipsum template, so treat independence as unverified, not proven.
issues.fix: Confirm European Granite's ownership and branch count before outreach; otherwise no other exclusion fixes needed.
